release_decision.reason: All identified RC5 audit gaps have static code/config/test remediation in RC6, but runtime, database, container, Kubernetes, mobile-device, recovery, and staging evidence is still missing.
release_decision.promotion_rule: Do not promote until all mandatory runtime and staging gates pass against the same commit and image digest.

development_summary: Reaudited RC5 across tenant isolation, authorization, privileged authentication, restore, async jobs, deployment, supply chain, observability, frontend, and mobile.
Closed six RC5 High findings statically and added contract/regression controls to prevent silent rollback of those protections.
Extended remediation into Medium and Low findings where implementation could be completed without external infrastructure.
Split large controllers/services into concerns so authorization and tenant boundaries are easier to review and test.

high_findings_closed_static.title: Dashboard global cross-tenant isolation
implementation: Explicit dashboard module registry.
Per-module entitlement and authorization checks.
Platform telemetry datasets restricted to super administrators.
Dataset construction rechecks tenant/platform scope instead of trusting the URL module name.

high_findings_closed_static.title: Privilege change MFA and authorization generation
implementation: Authorization generation is stored in sessions and personal access tokens.
Role, membership, permission, password, account status, and MFA changes revoke sessions/PATs and increment authorization state.
Privileged base roles and privileged custom roles require MFA.
Administration of memberships, roles, and permission overrides requires step-up MFA.
Mobile tokens are device-bound and use narrow abilities.

high_findings_closed_static.title: Restore security-state replay
implementation: Normal tenant restore excludes membership, custom-role, permission, and control-plane security state.
Security-state restore is a separate explicit mode with stronger approval requirements.
Restore approvals are bound to approver authorization generation, backup fingerprint, and approved change hash.
Restore execution revalidates approvals immediately before mutation and revokes affected tenant credentials after security-state changes.

high_findings_closed_static.title: Atomic canary rollback
implementation: Canary PodTemplate image and revision labels are changed in one atomic patch.
The prior verified PodTemplate is snapshotted before rollout.
Rollback restores the explicit prior template rather than relying on a single ambiguous rollout undo.
Runtime pod image digest is checked after rollout and rollback.

high_findings_closed_static.title: Critical-flow canary validation
implementation: In-cluster synthetic canary covers privileged MFA login, tenant rejection, idempotent mutation, queue roundtrip, database access, signed storage read/delete, broadcast/Reverb publish, and actual running image verification.
Synthetic operations use dedicated identities and cleanup paths so the canary can be rerun safely.

high_findings_closed_static.title: Mobile privileged MFA
implementation: Mobile login supports MFA challenge, TOTP, and recovery factor.
Device identity is included in login and MFA completion.
Expired/revoked credentials clear local authentication state.
Mobile API tokens use device binding and a narrow mobile ability instead of wildcard privileges.

tenant_and_authorization: Tenant-bound resources fail closed without an active tenant.
Workflow authorization uses both resource write permission and action-specific abilities.
Entitlement, subscription state, module allowlist, and quota are enforced request-side.
Mutation and audit writes share a transaction boundary.
Minimum-owner invariant is serialized with a tenant-scoped lock.
Application validation plus database migration/triggers reject tenant-null and cross-tenant identity changes for tenant-bound tables.
async_and_storage: Import/export workers and artifact downloads/deletions reauthorize against current access state.
Artifact deletion verifies the object is actually absent before clearing metadata.
Queue monitoring reads Redis and runtime worker heartbeat rather than assuming database queues.
Long queue visibility timeouts are separated from short jobs and validated against worker timeouts.
backup_and_recovery: Restore uses distributed locking, atomic worker claim, and a coherent transaction for mutation/status/audit.
Backup key rotation writes a new object version, verifies decrypt/checksum, swaps pointers transactionally, and records cleanup/orphan failures.
PITR uses MySQL tooling, snapshot coordinates, binlog rotation handling, and a concurrent-writer drill path.
qr_security: QR attendance requires a registered mobile scanner device, short-lived challenge, HMAC proof, allowed campus network, tenant/user binding, and single use.
A screenshot of the QR code alone is no longer sufficient to record attendance.
operations_and_observability: Production readiness probes KMS encrypt/decrypt, signed storage read/delete, queue roundtrip, SMTP, Reverb, runtime heartbeats, backup age, Alertmanager, and Loki.
Alertmanager, Loki, and Promtail were added; Promtail does not receive the Docker socket.
Compose deployment stores the previous image, drains workers, verifies running services, and performs validated rollback.
Kubernetes NetworkPolicy is rendered for the deployment namespace instead of being fixed to default.
supply_chain: GitHub Actions are pinned to full commit SHAs.
Deployment verifies image signature, provenance, SBOM attestation, and expected identity/issuer before rollout.
Admission policy and immutable image/base-image controls are included as deployment templates.
Gradle distribution checksum and pinned infrastructure image inputs were added where applicable.
frontend_mobile_quality: Production CSP browser guard and performance budget checks were added.
Runtime third-party fonts and frontend demo credentials were removed.
Favicon and OpenAPI license metadata were repaired.
Controller/service bounded contexts were split into concerns.
Regression tests were updated for device identity, MFA, authorization generation, and scanner proof flows.

static_validation.source_tree: The validation below applies to the source tree packaged as RC6 before this memory-only update.
static_validation.zip_integrity: PASS; .git excluded and packaged source matched the validated tree

not_run_and_still_mandatory: Composer validate/audit, Artisan commands, PHPUnit, and full migration execution.
MySQL 8.4 fresh migration, rollback, trigger behavior, query plans, concurrency, and lock tests.
npm ci, production Vite build, Redocly/OpenAPI CLI, npm audit, and full Playwright execution with production headers.
Docker/Podman image build, Trivy scan, SBOM/provenance inspection, and runtime Cosign verification.
Kubernetes multi-replica canary, deterministic routing, migration timeout/termination, rollback, NetworkPolicy, and admission enforcement.
Flutter analyze/test/build, signed AAB installation, device MFA, secure storage, scanner, and revoked-token behavior.
KMS, object storage, SMTP, Reverb, Alertmanager, Loki, queue, worker, scheduler, and storage-delete integration.
Staging backup/restore, security-state restore, PITR, key rotation, disaster-recovery drill, load/soak/chaos, penetration test, and privacy/compliance review.
mandatory_release_acceptance: Run all runtime and staging gates against the same immutable commit and image digest.
Verify image signature, identity, issuer, provenance, and SBOM before deployment and through cluster admission.
Demonstrate negative tenant-isolation and revoked-permission tests for CRUD, dashboard, workflow, jobs, downloads, and restore.
Demonstrate privilege promotion/demotion, custom-role changes, MFA rotation, and restore invalidating prior sessions and PATs.
Demonstrate deterministic canary routing, revision-local metrics, critical-flow synthetic checks, and explicit rollback to the prior verified template.
Complete backup, restore, security-state restore, PITR, key rotation, and disaster-recovery exercises with evidence and named approvers.
Complete mobile release and real-device tests for MFA, secure storage, device-bound tokens, QR scanner proof, and revoked authorization state.
Record machine evidence, owner approval, and any temporary risk acceptance with owner and expiry.
invariants_future_changes_must_preserve: Never allow a tenant-bound request to run without an explicit active tenant, including super administrators.
Never derive workflow authorization from base roles alone; use resource permission plus action-specific ability at mutation time.
Never grant or expand privileged access without verified MFA readiness, step-up MFA, authorization-generation bump, and credential revocation.
Never include security/control-plane state in a normal tenant data restore.
Never trust a restore approval unless approver authorization generation, backup fingerprint, and approved change hash still match.
Never expose platform telemetry through tenant dashboard module names or unregistered routes.
Never treat /health alone as a canary acceptance gate.
Never update canary image and revision labels through separate PodTemplate mutations.
Never accept a mobile privileged token without device binding and a narrow ability.
Never record QR attendance from the QR token alone; scanner challenge proof and network/device binding are mandatory.
Never report a storage delete, key rotation, restore, rollout, or rollback as successful without verifying the resulting state.
Never mark a runtime-dependent gate PASS when its required tool or infrastructure was unavailable.
next_agent: Read this file after memory/2026-07-12-system-audit.json; the earlier file describes the original system/UI baseline, while this file describes the RC5 audit and RC6 hardening state.
Start by running Composer install/validate/audit and PHPUnit against MySQL 8.4; static PHP syntax is not sufficient evidence for migrations, triggers, transactions, and locks.
Run npm ci, production build, CSP Playwright, OpenAPI lint, dependency audit, and the performance budget before changing frontend code.
Run Flutter analyze/test/build and device tests before altering mobile authentication or QR scanner flows.
Deploy only to staging first; exercise KMS, storage, SMTP, Reverb, Redis queues, worker/scheduler heartbeats, Alertmanager/Loki, backup/restore/PITR, canary, and rollback.
Use backend/scripts/check-hardening-contracts.mjs after any security or deployment change and extend it when adding new invariants.
Keep backend/tests/Feature/Rc6HardeningTest.php and the updated tenant/production hardening tests aligned with all authorization and restore changes.
Do not weaken controls merely to make legacy tests pass; update tests to use step-up MFA, device identity, current authorization generation, and scanner proof.
Do not call RC6 production-ready until runtime/staging evidence is attached to the exact commit and image digest.
